# apipbx_voicemail_greeting (Resource)

A voicemail greeting. Import with "<tenant id>/<box id>/<type>" (the audio is then replaced by the configured file on the next apply).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_base64` (String) The WAV file, base64 encoded: filebase64("away.wav"). 16-bit PCM, mono, 8000 Hz.
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `type` (String) unavailable or busy (replace the default prompts), name (the spoken name) or temporary (overrides the others).
- `voicemail_box_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `duration_seconds` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
